PlannedType Period fhir=Period kind=complex-type
  embeds Element
  field Start *string json=start optional=true primitive
  field StartElement *fhir.PrimitiveElement json=_start optional=true sibling-of=Start
  field End *string json=end optional=true primitive
  field EndElement *fhir.PrimitiveElement json=_end optional=true sibling-of=End
